units.source_text: “我和K虽然同属一系，但专业不同，离家和回家的时间自然也早晚不同。

en.t: Although K and I belonged to the same course, our specialties were different, so naturally the times when we left and returned home were not the same.

units.source_text: 如果我回来得早，便穿过他的空屋子，回来得晚，便如往常一样跟他打声招呼，走进自己的房间。

en.t: If I came back early, I simply passed through his empty room; if I came back late, I greeted him as usual and went into my own room.

units.source_text: 每次K总是放下书，朝拉开门的我看一眼，说一声：‘刚回来？’

en.t: Each time, K would put down his book, glance at me as I opened the door, and say, 'Just got back?'

units.source_text: 有时我只是点点头，有时‘嗯’一声，走过去。

en.t: Sometimes I merely nodded; at other times I answered, 'Mm,' and walked on past.
